row_guide: Band0 (0–768): dense traffic signs (warning/mandatory/parking/street blades); ornate+modern+cobra lamps; benches; playground slide/swings; candy/food carts; phone booths; ATM/parking meters/mailbox; fountains; early traffic lights; fences/sawhorses/bollards; green dumpsters & trash; hydrants; flower boxes/oval planters/hedges; round+cypress+planter trees; shrubs; electric poles/manholes/grates; billboards; clotheslines; underground parking arches. Band1 (768–1536): wind turbine; electric boxes; power house; water tower modular; shipping containers tan/blue (+modular); yard clutter (tires/pallets/spools/pipes/barrels); toxic barrels+danger signs; junk piles; car wrecks (side/stacked/flipped/on-side); site office/junk shack/corrugated fence; security booths+stop barriers; HVAC/satellite/solar/roof lights; green dumpster sides; green garbage truck facings; litter. Band2 (1536–2304): blue dumpsters; orange garbage truck facings; EV chargers/terminals; tall signal poles; bollards/bike rails; huge multi-facing traffic-sign grids (new/warning/yield/modular); cones; no-entry barriers; cantilever traffic masts L/R/diagonal with arrow plates and RYG modules; pedestrian boxes. Band3 (2304–3072): assembled mast examples; concrete bridge pillars; diagonal railings; modular pavement; blue-rail stairs+EXAMPLE; grand modular staircase; hex water; N-S asphalt dashed road; diagonal lane tiles; elevated overpass; sidewalk corners; front stairs; wires; wall posters; paper trash; brake marks. Band4 (3072–3584): elevated platform corners/straights/stairs; mushroom/icecream/coffee/infopoint kiosks (+shutters/hollows/interiors); heart A-frames/pedestals/flags; drones/controllers.
